purpose: Formula-driven planning budget for Temper PFC input power against the Breville Control Freak US nameplate class

source.source_limit: Supports the appliance input benchmark only; does not establish efficiency, PF waveform, auxiliary power, DC output, low-line behavior, or pan power.

assumptions.auxiliary_allocation: DC-bus-fed auxiliary budget only; actual supply topology unbound. For AC-fed auxiliaries use eta*(P_mains-P_aux_AC).

existing_coverage_gap: Nine discrete accepted PFC-model points do not include a measured 1800 W whole-appliance input point.
Ideal auxiliary rails omit physical fans, controller bias, inverter consumption, and real auxiliary power.
Existing Irms values are model screens, not complete-appliance current or PF evidence.
No continuous thermal, magnetic, capacitor-ripple, or cooking-performance result follows from the current campaign.
acceptance_requirements: Measure synchronized whole-appliance Vrms, Irms, real W, VA, and PF at 108/120/132 V.
Enforce mains_limit_w = min(1800, V * 15 * PF) including low-line foldback.
Measure PFC input, DC-bus output, and physical auxiliary rails to replace planning assumptions.
Sustain the selected 120 V target while recording bus ripple, magnetic and semiconductor stress, capacitor ripple, and temperatures.
Qualify the downstream inverter and cooking behavior separately; do not call inverter input pan power.
Requalify protection on the changed topology.
Declare settled RMS window separately from startup/inrush limits; the power equation is not an instantaneous trip law.

arithmetic_check.nominal_120v_pf_0_99: 1782.0 W mains -> 1692.9 W DC bus at 95% -> 1672.9 W inverter input after 20 W auxiliaries
arithmetic_check.exact_1800w_at_120v: Requires PF >= 1.0 to remain at or below 15 A RMS; PF 0.99 would require 15.151515 A
